# Analysis

## Note on Comparability: Alaska Air Group

Alaska Air Group's FY2024 revenue includes results from Hawaiian Holdings, which Alaska acquired on September 18, 2024. Per the acquisition note: "For the period from the acquisition date to December 31, 2024, revenue... from Hawaiian recognized in the Company's consolidated results of operations was $869 million" [DOC-2]. Since Hawaiian was not part of Alaska's consolidated results in FY2022 or FY2023, I adjust Alaska's FY2024 reported revenue of $11,735M [DOC-1] down by $869M to $10,866M to calculate organic (like-for-like) growth for Alaska in both periods. No other airlines in this set are flagged as having comparable acquisition-driven revenue distortions.

## Revenue Growth Calculations (using Alaska ex-Hawaiian)

All base revenue figures from [DOC-1]; Alaska FY2024 adjusted per [DOC-2].

**FY2023 → FY2024 growth:**
| Airline | FY2023 | FY2024 (adj.) | Growth % |
|---|---|---|---|
| United | $53,717M | $57,063M | 6.23% |
| Delta | $58,048M | $61,643M | 6.19% |
| Southwest | $26,091M | $27,483M | 5.34% |
| Alaska | $10,426M | $10,866M (ex-Hawaiian) | 4.22% |
| American | $52,788M | $54,211M | 2.70% |

**Ranking (2023→2024):** United > Delta > Southwest > Alaska > American

**FY2022 → FY2024 growth:**
| Airline | FY2022 | FY2024 (adj.) | Growth % |
|---|---|---|---|
| United | $44,955M | $57,063M | 26.94% |
| Delta | $50,582M | $61,643M | 21.87% |
| Southwest | $23,814M | $27,483M | 15.41% |
| Alaska | $9,646M | $10,866M (ex-Hawaiian) | 12.65% |
| American | $48,971M | $54,211M | 10.70% |

**Ranking (2022→2024):** United > Delta > Southwest > Alaska > American

## Conclusion

In both the one-year (FY2023→FY2024) and two-year (FY2022→FY2024) growth rankings, **United Airlines Holdings** ranks first, narrowly ahead of Delta in the shorter period and more clearly ahead of Delta over the two-year period. The full rank order (United > Delta > Southwest > Alaska > American) is identical in both timeframes.

ANSWER: Yes — United Airlines Holdings is the top-ranked airline by revenue growth in both the FY2023→FY2024 period (6.23% vs. Delta's 6.19%) and the FY2022→FY2024 period (26.94% vs. Delta's 21.87%), with the full ranking order (United, Delta, Southwest, Alaska, American) identical across both periods. Alaska's figures exclude the Hawaiian Holdings acquisition (completed Sept. 18, 2024) for comparability, since Hawaiian was not part of Alaska's results in the prior periods.
